facts.fact: BTPnews reports the land agency ANCFCC has generalised electronic signature in its work, as set out at its board of 8 July 2025.

MAR.note: Sovereignty is mentioned only in general terms; no rule or hosting of state data is stated.
No law on electronic transactions is stated.

facts.fact: BTPnews reports ANCFCC created over 373,000 land titles in 2024, with its whole cartographic archive digitised and georeferenced and cadastral requests processed automatically.
BTPnews reports ANCFCC issued over 2 million certificates through its digital channels in 2024 and set up digital counters.

systems.owner: Agence Nationale de la Conservation Fonciere, du Cadastre et de la Cartographie
